def axis_of(cls): return [int(float(x)) for x in class_joint[cls]['axis'].split()]
def rng_of(cls):
    r=class_joint[cls].get('range')
    return [float(x) for x in r.split()] if r else None

# joint name -> class (thigh class depends on front/back)
leg_thigh_cls={'FL':'front_hip','FR':'front_hip','RL':'back_hip','RR':'back_hip'}
joints=[{"name":"free_base","type":"free","axis":None,"ctrlrange":None}]
for leg in ['FL','FR','RL','RR']:
    joints.append({"name":f"{leg}_hip_joint","type":"hinge","axis":axis_of('abduction'),"ctrlrange":rng_of('abduction')})
    tc=leg_thigh_cls[leg]
    joints.append({"name":f"{leg}_thigh_joint","type":"hinge","axis":axis_of(tc),"ctrlrange":rng_of(tc)})
    joints.append({"name":f"{leg}_calf_joint","type":"hinge","axis":axis_of('knee'),"ctrlrange":rng_of('knee')})
